scares.description: Trevor begins screaming while coming out of a box.
There is a loud banging noise while Ellison is in the attic.
Ellison lifts a box lid to uncover a snake.
Ellison falls through the attic floor.
Bughuul’s face on Ellison’s laptop begins to move.
Ellison lowers the print of Bughuul’s face only to see the same face mirrored in the backyard outside.
Ellison sees Trevor’s face hiding in the bushes.
Several deceased children are seen standing behind Ellison.
A tied up body suddenly comes into view in front of lawnmower.
A deceased girl appears beside Ellison.
A deceased girl in a yellow coat appears in the hallway.
A deceased girl sits beside Ashley’s bed.
Bughuul’s face suddenly appears in front of Ellison while he is peering into the attic.
A box labelled home movies drops from the attic and lands on the floor beside Ellison.
Bughuul’s face abruptly drops into view, just before the final credits roll.
